name: 昙香囊
flavor: 香囊里装的不是花，是花谢之后剩下的东西。

art.subject: a small embroidered violet sachet tied with black cord, a withered white night flower peeking out, faint green vapor seeping from the seams

name: 柳絮扇
text: 你的[手牌上限]+2。战斗开始时，抽2张牌。
flavor: 扇面上的人，每次打开都不一样。

art.subject: a half-open folding fan painted with a faceless woman beneath willow branches, catkins seeming to drift off the paper, soft lamplight

name: 蚀骨香
text: 战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加2层[中毒]。
flavor: 点一炷，满屋都是花香；闻久了，骨头会疼。

art.subject: a slender incense stick in a violet lacquer holder, sickly green-purple smoke curling into the shape of blossoms, dark background

name: 絮影囊
text: 每回合你第一次[弃置]牌后，对一名随机敌人施加3层[中毒]。
flavor: 柳絮里掺了夜昙的花粉，风一吹，落在谁身上谁就发痒。

art.subject: a small silk pouch stuffed with drifting white willow catkins, some floating out of its mouth, pale violet ribbon

name: 残局谱
text: 每回合打出第一张牌后，将一张[浮光]的「棋子」加入手牌。
flavor: 谱上的局，他下了一辈子也没下完。

art.subject: an old silk scroll of an unfinished go game, a few stones tucked into its folds

name: 棋枰
text: 每回合打出第3张牌后，获得1枚临时[源]。
flavor: 木纹里嵌着十九道金线。

art.subject: a thick wooden go board with gold-inlaid grid lines and purple stone bowls
